body: 主動發現清單外競品 Solid Biosciences（NASDAQ: SLDB）：Friedreich's Ataxia 基因療法 SGT-212 首次人體 Ph1b（NCT07180355）自 2025/10 收案中，採雙側小腦齒狀核注輸＋靜脈雙途徑遞送——正對應 Biogen BIIB132 折戟的深部小腦遞送難題；已建立競品全景、公司情報卡與試驗各一筆，追蹤競品數 20→21。另補收 PTC Therapeutics 新 Ph3「PROVE-FA」（NCT07681713，n≈120、24 個月、主要指標 mFARS、估 2026/08 起始），惟為單臂開放標籤無對照設計。新增 3 則科學文獻：SCA3 類澱粉聚集抑制（肉桂芽多酚，線蟲模型）、SCA3 認知障礙靜息態 fMRI（n=84）、共濟失調病人自述視功能與眼動關聯（MGH／哈佛）。

en.body: Discovered an off-list competitor, Solid Biosciences (NASDAQ: SLDB): its Friedreich's ataxia gene therapy SGT-212 has been recruiting into a first-in-human Ph1b (NCT07180355) since 2025/10, using dual-route delivery via bilateral cerebellar dentate-nucleus infusion plus IV — aimed at the deep-cerebellar delivery problem that sank Biogen's BIIB132. Added as a competitor-landscape row, a company card and a trial; tracked competitors 20 → 21. Also captured PTC Therapeutics' new Ph3, PROVE-FA (NCT07681713; n≈120 over 24 months, primary endpoint mFARS, estimated start 2026/08), though it is single-arm, open-label and uncontrolled. Added 3 papers: suppression of ataxin-3 amyloid aggregation by cinnamon-bud polyphenols in a C. elegans model, resting-state fMRI in SCA3 with cognitive impairment (n=84), and patient-reported visual function and its oculomotor correlates in ataxias (MGH / Harvard).

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：SCA2 前臨床期辨識的多變量 MRI 模型（Tomography，墨西哥／古巴 Holguín 團隊）——以多項 MRI 線性測量區辨健康對照、ATXN2 前臨床帶因者與已發病者，整體準確率 80.7%（前臨床 AUC 0.75）。五組適應症 CT.gov 掃描（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyQ／CACNA1A）近 7 天無清單外新療法試驗，SBMA 組命中皆為前列腺癌雄性素路徑試驗之字面誤中；本社與 Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead 亦無新監管或臨床動態。

en.body: Added 1 paper: a multivariate MRI model for identifying the preclinical stage of SCA2 (Tomography; Mexican / Cuban Holguín groups) that discriminates healthy controls, preclinical ATXN2 carriers and manifest patients with 80.7% overall accuracy (preclinical AUC 0.75). The five-indication CT.gov sweep (SCA/Friedreich/SBMA/polyQ/CACNA1A) found no off-list therapy trials in the last 7 days — the SBMA hits were all literal false matches from prostate-cancer androgen-pathway studies — and there was no new regulatory or clinical movement from Steminent, Biohaven, Vico or Arrowhead.

body: 新增 4 則科學文獻，其中 MSC 治療小腦共濟失調系統性回顧（CNS Neurosci Ther，韓國慶北大學）直接支持異體策略——共濟失調病人自體 MSC 的抗發炎分泌體能力低於健康捐贈者，且 SCA2 模型症狀後給藥仍見療效；另收 SCA2 N140 電生理生物標記、SBMA 肌肉 MRI 影像生物標記（Neurology）與 polyQ 多系統病理回顧。主動發現清單外競品 Nido Biosciences（NIDO-361，口服 SARM，SBMA／polyQ 鄰域）：Ph2（NCT06411912，n=54）主要終點肌肉 MRI 瘦肌肉體積未見優於安慰劑，2026/03 登錄公告結果，公司於 2026 年初結束營運——已建立競品全景、公司情報卡、試驗與結果讀出各一筆。追蹤競品數 19→20。

en.body: Added 4 papers. The systematic review of MSC therapy for cerebellar ataxia (CNS Neurosci Ther, Kyungpook National University, Korea) directly supports an allogeneic strategy — MSCs from ataxia patients have weaker anti-inflammatory secretome capacity than healthy-donor MSCs, and efficacy in the SCA2 model held even when dosing began after symptom onset. Also added an SCA2 N140 electrophysiology biomarker, an SBMA muscle-MRI imaging biomarker (Neurology) and a review of polyQ multisystem pathology. Discovered an off-list competitor, Nido Biosciences (NIDO-361, an oral SARM in SBMA / the adjacent polyQ ring): its Ph2 (NCT06411912, n=54) showed no advantage over placebo on the primary muscle-MRI lean muscle volume endpoint, results were posted to the registry in 2026/03, and the company wound down in early 2026 — now recorded as a competitor-landscape row, a company card, a trial and a results readout. Tracked competitors 19 → 20.

body: 新增競品試驗 Lexeo LX2006 SUNRISE-FA 2（NCT07721025，AAVrh.10hFXN 基因療法，Friedreich's Ataxia 相關心肌病變，Ph2 註冊型，2026/06/25 啟動、現正收案，主要指標＝心臟 MRI 左心室質量指數變化）；同步更新競品全景中 Lexeo 一列的狀態。五組適應症 CT.gov 掃描（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyQ／CACNA1A）與 PubMed 近 7 天未見其他清單外新競品或新文獻。

en.body: Added a competitor trial, Lexeo LX2006 SUNRISE-FA 2 (NCT07721025, AAVrh.10hFXN gene therapy, Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, Ph2 registrational, started 2026/06/25 and now recruiting, primary endpoint = change in LV mass index by cardiac MRI); the Lexeo row in the competitor landscape was updated accordingly. The five-indication CT.gov sweep (SCA/Friedreich/SBMA/polyQ/CACNA1A) and the 7-day PubMed scan surfaced no other off-list competitors or new papers.
